content.text:
The report is valid, and your [hk v2 discussion](https://github.com/jdx/hk/discussions/1261) points to the clean solution.

- editorconfig-checker v3 installs only `ec`.
- v4 installs only `editorconfig-checker`; I verified v4.0.1 directly.
- Automatic shell detection would weaken hk’s structured-argv design and complicate Windows behavior.
- Adding `editorconfig_checker_v4` would recreate the variant explosion you explicitly called out in the v2 discussion.

Recommended v2 API:

```pkl
["editorconfig_checker"] = Builtins.editorconfig_checker // v4 default
```

For users retaining v3:

```pkl
["editorconfig_checker"] = (Builtins.editorconfig_checker) {
  version = "3"
}
```

That belongs in [PR #1253](https://github.com/jdx/hk/pull/1253), alongside the existing `pinact.version` precedent. The default step should invoke `editorconfig-checker`, while `version = "3"` selects `ec`.

For hk v1, I’d keep `ec` and advise users to pin editorconfig-checker 3.11.3 or override the command. Changing the v1 default would simply break pinned-v3 installations in the opposite direction.

There is also a separate live mise/aqua packaging problem: installing v4.0.1 currently searches for the old `ec-darwin-*.tar.gz` asset names, while v4 publishes `editorconfig-checker-darwin-all.tar.gz`. That should be reported to aqua-registry independently.
